Mass Spectrometry images of lipids were collected with a Bruker Daltonics MALDI timsTOF fleX at 10.000000 micron from m/z 150.000000-2000.000000 in positive ion mode.  Support was provided by the NIH Common Fund and National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases (U54 DK120058).
